verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents keyboard-driven tiling: windows can be toggled between tiling and floating, and you can switch between dwindle and scrolling layouts. A hands-on user also confirms the tiling suits a multitasking workflow. missing for 10: documentation of explicit snapping or moving windows into specific layout positions, detail on the range of predefined layouts beyond dwindle and scrolling, and independent in-depth corroboration of the layout features.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snap and tile windows into predefined layouts for multitasking

citations.quote: `Super + T` Toggle window between tiling/floating ... `Super + L` Toggle between dwindle and scrolling layout
the tiling matches how I use my Mac
